title: Lead Leak Check output
description: One dataset item per risk report (0-100 score, counts by severity, ranked findings with why/fix) plus a combined Markdown report in the key-value store.

results.title: Risk reports
results.description: Dataset items, one per analysed input (description, config or run-history CSV): inputType, pipeline, risk_score, counts, findings[], notes[], report_markdown.

report.title: Markdown report
report.description: REPORT.md record in the default key-value store: all reports of the run as one Markdown document.
